sourceDesc.p: Based on the Register of Mattheson’s Grosse General-Baß-Schule (Hamburg 1731, pp. 465–482), transcribed in register/register_1731.xml.

editorialDecl.p: The index takes up every entry of Mattheson’s Register about a subject (“Sachen”) that refers to a page of the Ober-Classe (pp. 302–464). Entries about persons (“Nahmen”) and works are covered by the indices of persons, literature and musical works. Each item is one term: label with type="reg" gives the modern German form, type="orig" Mattheson’s headword as printed in the Register, gloss an English equivalent, and ptr with type="register" points to the Register entries the term is built from. Where Mattheson indexes one matter under several headwords (e.g. Fürsten, Printzen, Hertzogliche Personen), they are combined in one term.

listRef lists the passages. A ref with type="register" stands for one page reference of the Register: n is Mattheson’s page, corresp the Register entry it comes from, target the place in the edition. References added by the editors have type="editorial". The content of a ref quotes the passage; term marks the word that is tagged in the transcription with <term corresp="#…">. scripts/tag_terms.py does the tagging and completes target; a target without a fragment means that the word is not tagged yet (the transcriptions of Probstücke 8, 10–14, 16, 17 and 22 are being revised, their passages are tagged once the new transcriptions are in). Where no single word answers Mattheson’s reference, target points to the score, a music example, a paragraph, or only to the text of the Probstück.
